cd /workspace
echo "=== actual OS procs for jura-db/begruendungen (18021/18022) ==="
ps -eo pid,etimes,rss,args --no-headers | grep -E "18021|18022" | grep -v grep | awk '{print $1, "age="$2"s", int($3/1024)"MB", substr($0, index($0,$4),60)}'
echo "=== total python mem ==="; ps -eo rss,args --no-headers | grep -E "python main.py|db_pipelines|jura_db|begrundungen" | grep -v grep | awk '{s+=$1} END {print int(s/1024)"MB"}'
echo "=== top mem procs ==="; ps -eo rss,args --no-headers | sort -rn | head -6 | awk '{print int($1/1024)"MB", substr($0, index($0,$2), 55)}'
